subject.title: Feature Request: Add MathJax/LaTeX Support to Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw core accept opt-in Control UI math rendering as a built-in UI feature, including the config, dependency, and sanitizer surface proposed by the open KaTeX PRs?
rationale: The request is useful and VISION-aligned as web frontend ergonomics, but it is not a strict bug fix: the proposed paths add a public config contract, a new UI dependency, and sanitizer changes for untrusted chat content.

options.title: Sponsor core math rendering
options.body: Accept a default-off Control UI math-rendering feature and require the candidate PR to resolve parser, proof, dependency, and sanitizer blockers before merge.

options.title: Keep the demand signal pending
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical tracker while maintainers defer the dependency/config/security tradeoff.

options.title: Reject core support for now
options.body: Close the cluster only if maintainers decide math rendering should live outside core or wait for a different extension surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor core math rendering
recommendation.body: Accept a default-off Control UI math-rendering feature and require the candidate PR to resolve parser, proof, dependency, and sanitizer blockers before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice spans product, config, dependency, and security acceptance rather than only renderer code ownership.
